name: 1204-longgen-llama2-13b-1gpu
model: meta-llama/Llama-2-13b-chat-hf, fp16. The repo is `gated: manual` -- request access first; ~26 GB, and not in the local HF cache, so the first run downloads it.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 13B: 40 layers, 40 query heads over 40 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 5120, intermediate 13824, vocab 32000, 4096 trained positions.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=128, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 1280 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn over `/v1/completions`: prompts centred on 256 tokens (stdev 64, clamped 128-384), generations centred on 1024 tokens (stdev 128, clamped 768-1280), every request an independent draw. `temperature: 0`, seed 42.
purpose: A long-form story and article writer on a 13B chat model, 128 concurrent users, short prompts, single H100.
launch:
# sglang at commit 61bb223e0fc1ccd0c26ac3137f0d9154bcecc25a (`git describe --tags` =
# v0.2.13-45-g61bb223e0fc). Flat `key: value` only -- the reader takes the file line by line and
# skips indented ones, so a structured value must stay on ONE line or the key is silently dropped.

model-path: meta-llama/Llama-2-13b-chat-hf
tp-size: 1
dtype: float16
disable-radix-cache: true

# The engine's own default at tp-size 1, written out rather than left implicit. Lower it if
# CUDA-graph capture OOMs.
mem-fraction-static: 0.88

# This release captures CUDA graphs for [1, 2, 4] + [i*8 for i in 1..20]; past 160
# concurrently-running requests the engine leaves the graph path for eager Python.
max-running-requests: 160

random-seed: 42
